claim: Every folder carries the SSIC, the open and close dates, and the disposal instructions
quote: Labels will include the schedule number, SSIC, file title, and the disposition instructions. Include the year of accumulation
fix: State the label has four elements: schedule number, SSIC, file title and disposition instructions, plus the year of accumulation for time cutoffs. The manual sets no open and close dates. Review IGMC legal checklist item 0301 against this paragraph.

claim: Labeling is required for all folders and containers, paragraph 2-2
quote: Label all folders and containers used to store official records.

claim: Files with permanent or fixed-year retention are cut off at the end of the year action is complete, Table 3-1
quote: Files with permanent retention or retention for a specific number of years are cut off at the end of the year in which action on

claim: SSIC 5830 is for legal administrative files
fix: Describe 5830 as Courts of Inquiry and Investigations. Use 5800 through 5829 per the SSIC table for other legal files.

claim: Filing arrangement by name, last name first (paragraph 1-6)
quote: Filed by last name, first name and middle initial, for example, Smith, John R.
